__m.name: Vengeance
__m.lore: A strength fueled by rage, merciless, unending. A hatred, all-consuming, that erodes all other thought, all sense of being. An ally so fickle, so selfish, that leaves you aimless at the moment of pyrrhic triumph.

__m.name: Last Stand
__m.lore: You're the only one left. The only light remaining to lift this world out of endless night. Push on; one day, you may make it.

__m.name: Phanerozoic
__m.lore: An age of transformation. To shape the evolution of life, as if molding a piece of clay. To gain intelligence, and become the harbingers of creation and destruction. To build control, and become the hand of fate. Here, we begin.

__m.name: Autopilot
__m.lore: Wouldn't it be nice to just let go and let something else take the wheel every now and then?

__m.name: Xiuhtecuhtli
__m.lore: This turquoise mask burns into your skin, binding flesh and stone. The flames are a constant reminder of the balance between creation and destruction, and that the fire which sustains can also consume.

__m.name: Ahriman
__m.lore: Your limbs fail you, and yet you still stand. Something, someone, has invaded your body, and it will use you until your last breath.

__m.name: Nexus
__m.lore: Where thought converges, the veil thins.

__m.name: Nonexistence
__m.lore: What lies beneath the brim of all that never was, that overflowing vastness which cannot spill?

__m.name: Panopticon
__m.lore: There is nothing in these walls that will remain hidden forever. Nothing unaccounted for by the gleaming light of The Citadel.

__m.name: Heretic
__m.lore: What once crowned the Commander of Aelumia's Gendarmerie, now reduced to a singed fragment of its former self.

__m.name: Crown of Jewels
__m.lore: A symbol of authority, power, and the right to rule. Let Her leadership burn brightly forevermore, leading us into a new era of strength.

__m.name: Astrolabe
__m.lore:
There is an ornate inscription entwined with a runic design on the back.
necel il etlduhsulludaces kec keslud cef. duhesnef il nahes toc netl ifikc uc kricr lifrah.
14  7al sifkel

__m.name: Nova
__m.lore: There is a certain fascination to what lies beyond our grasp, to the spaces we cannot quite see. Harness that pull, draw in your foe, bend it to your will. What could go wrong?

__m.name: Aureole
__m.lore: Double vision reshapes the moon's halo into the irises of an angel - radiant in their delicate, celestial beauty. Astigmatic lights sharpen into heavenly blades and you are the martyr to wield them.

__m.name: Shattered Aurora
__m.lore: The shifting mosaic that graces the winter skies has always struck you as a faint trace of some grand precursor, pure and whole. As you look up at what remains, fragmented beyond the horizon, you can't help but wonder what it would take to break it once more.

__m.name: Gleam
__m.lore: History measures empires; what are you, if not but a subtle flicker-masked within the brilliance of generations past?

__m.name: Gambler's Ruin
__m.lore: Those who believe in chances are the most foolish - every step forward is a step closer to demise. Greed blinds their eyes, as it guides their souls to eternal despair.

__m.name: Mesmerizing Madness
__m.lore: Sink into infinite synchronous beats with the intricate rhythm of fractals and spirals and patterns, and patterns, and patterns that reach to the pulsating stars and then back to the ground where the people are dancing to songs they don't know under stars that turn ‘round, and around, and around, as the spiral is starting again . . .

__m.name: Fool's Errand
__m.lore: Is it bravery or stupidity that compels you to stare into the jaws of death once more?

__m.name: Crown of Vicious Leaves
__m.lore: The leaves in this coronet cackle and hiss, a cacophony of malicious intent. They would just as soon shred your enemies to bits as remove your own head from your shoulders.

__m.name: Last Sun
__m.lore: The falling sun shall be your demise.

__m.name: Inhumanity
__m.lore: Exploitation is a game as old as time, but rarely one to be played so transparently. When war reaches your doorstep, though, the facade of civility falls-there is no shame in bleeding an enemy dry.

__m.name: Champion's Valiance
__m.lore: These leggings were forged in honour of a martyr, who, legend has it, fought off a horde of the marauders for two days without food or rest to defend his village.

__m.name: Greaves of Purest Obsidian
__m.lore: Sleek black plates, harder than steel, tougher than granite. Threads of ancient magick weave themselves through the material, granting you all the power of the dark stone.

__m.name: Confiscated
__m.lore: She's taken all you have. Your blood. Your sweat. Your tears. You must repay the debt, no matter the consequences, so that what was stolen will be returned tenfold.

__m.name: Enshrouded Eruption
__m.lore: Recovered from subterranean ash deposits, these timeworn greaves are one of many relics of war buried in combat by an ancient eruption.  Entombed by millennia of rock and soil, the ideologies of the belligerents have been long forgotten: all that remains is their endless desire for absolution.

__m.name: Firewall
__m.lore: Some places must be protected at all costs. In a frigid, worldwide desert of apathy and ruination, there somehow still remain some oases of love and warmth. Keep them safe, as long as you can.

__m.name: Alstroemania
__m.lore: Look around and observe! An overcast sky; yet the blue of day seeps through the gloom, illuminating the land around you. A patch of weeds; yet flowers bloom vividly in spite of the wretched foliage surrounding them. The struggles of nature create your own personal utopia. A world, tailormade, just for you. Only you.

__m.name: Arsene
__m.lore: I am thou... Thou art I.

__m.name: Archean
__m.lore: An age of inundation. To overwhelm a vicious hell with immense waves, and protest the hand of fate. To harbor the beginning of life, and nurture a world of growth. From the fire, we are born.

__m.name: Samsara
__m.lore: Countless lifetimes flash by in an instant. Will you break the cycle, or be consumed by the tides of eternity?

__m.name: Xenolith
__m.lore: Hidden amongst the foundations of the Expanse are anomalous fragments wrapped in an otherworldly power. While unsettling to the touch, the strength they impart is too tempting to ignore.

__m.name: Dissenter's Refuge
__m.lore: Join the fight.

__m.name: Rebel Ethos
__m.lore: Stand up, fight back.

__m.name: Reviled Saviour
__m.lore: You will do what is right, whether they like it or not.

__m.name: Aleph Null
__m.lore: It's a strange feeling, running forever to reach the horizon knowing another lies just as far past.

__m.name: Rhyolitic Wrath
__m.lore: A rage has built up in the stones around you. A slow burn, a creeping fury gradually grown throughout the ages. It demands release.

__m.name: Carcinization
__m.lore: You awake in a cold sweat, finding yourself in control of two more arms and a hard exterior. You cannot make any sense of what is happening inside yourself. You cannot even explain it to yourself. How about you sleep a little bit longer and forget all this nonsense?

__m.name: Platonic Ideal
__m.lore: The intersection of what can be and what is. The apotheosis of being. Shear away the unclean, the impure, the rotten; leave only the raw, blinding truth of the self.

__m.name: Steadfast
__m.lore: Ground yourself. Your heart beats to the rhythm of the earth. With the weight of the world supporting you, nothing can break your stride.

__m.name: Null Space
__m.lore: What's the point of your journey if it all just leads to nothing?

__m.name: Skyline Bliss
__m.lore: The sky knows no bounds.

__m.name: Final Spark
__m.lore: You have gotten tired of the abyss staring back. Embrace it in a finale that leaves no survivors.

__m.name: Symphonie Fantastique
__m.lore: The most poignant anthems are the toils of a tortured soul, a haunting, heart-wrenching melody from which one can never turn away.

__m.name: Sepulchral Shackles
__m.lore: The grave leaves its mark on any who have been there. Few make it out; fewer still can bring their minds, too, back to life.

__m.name: Serene Storm
__m.lore: Barrages of rain and ice can bite and break; symphonies thunder and wind can deafen and crash. The worst storms, though, the kind that leave no survivors; those creep up quietly, steal in through the moonlit fields, and whisk the world away without a trace.

__m.name: Stalking Mist
__m.lore: akc il sascah ah ludadheftalhahes cof pahef cef, luh  ifikc uc setlrec trasped. las il palad aces il kif nikcpichul toc  uc trasped, pactef nahes il pichul cef. las il nikcpaladah sef icetl aces il itspahisahad toc atsif luh halatsif, luh nahes il kelcifif uc nikcisahed.

__m.name: Song of the Sea
__m.lore: A sweet tune permeates the air. A whistle on the waves; a melody from the depths. It calls forth destruction in seafoam and sand, and those who hear its call do not breathe for long.

__m.name: Hadean
__m.lore: An age of formation. To spark the chain reaction of everything, and to predate nothing. To bombard the world with violent impact after violent impact, building a beautiful, delicate foundation from the firestorm of the cosmos. All things must begin.

__m.name: Embrittlement
__m.lore: Shards of frost and bone, fragments of memories and worlds; it all shatters under your step. The cracks reach deep. Too deep. Your soul rests on thin ice.

__m.name: Wysteria Glooms
__m.lore: Every stride leaves a footstep of violet, trailing your path. The flower buds peek out of the ground as if nervous, and after a moment's hesitation, burgeon -- blooming hysteria into the hearts of man.

__m.name: Martingale
__m.lore: Every power has its costs, and every triumph has its toll. Wager everything you treasure-it will all be worth in the end.

__m.name: Static Cling
__m.lore: Forged in a hidden workshop, these boots were imbued with earthen quartz and bound lightning. Their wearer crackles with static energy, amplifying every strike. Many have chased this power, only to find themselves uprooted by its shocking embrace.

__m.name: Eternal Toil
__m.lore: Shift after shift, the workers gave everything they had. Quota after quota, even that was not enough. They could only take so much of this before their very spirit was forever broken.

__m.name: Excision of Trust
__m.lore: They'll never believe you again.

__m.name: Rewritten History
__m.lore: Alter your past to reshape your future.

__m.name: Clandestine
__m.lore: This bracelet holds a hastily scrawled diagram and message: tahkuhac ah pichul il nikckrah ceftif, necal cistodes il pahnikcredos. pulits pices il tahkuhac il pahnifkel sef icetlis pruts, hatl nec niftocos. tof il recnal toc rofmedos. nikcred kalkah, its kalahretsed nofmales uc lasec tofsifos.

__m.name: Threshold of Consciousness
__m.lore: The lights slowly begin to wink out, one by one. You don't have much time left at all.

__m.name: The Peak
__m.lore: Looking over the horizon, you suddenly realize the span of your journey. How far you've come. How far you'll go.

__m.name: Palimpsest
__m.lore: Beneath engravings of the Fruman capital, you can make out some text: nikcatl rakc il las uc kractif petstac ah krof cef. etlpices ah tahkuhac il kacetslah pahsecnof, luh nasef il tul kalofmes kacetslah toc nikckrof. tah il necel ledokcrid uc pestalos ac il las uc krahitsahosed, luh etlpasad il nikcpahsofmalos sef pecol uc traspedis, pactef tah il lah toc las uc uskadis.

__m.name: Devil's Oath
__m.lore: Branded on your skin reads: "No refunds!"

__m.name: Frondescere
__m.lore: Perched atop treetops far above, you watch the gentle sway of branches, leaves caressing the playful wind, and you finally feel at home.

__m.name: Impatience
__m.lore: "Doing it right" is a waste of time.

__m.name: Purple Prose
__m.lore: Your disputatious adversaries blanch at your consummate pugnacious ability, and, naturally, your superlative nous.

__m.name: Taurus
__m.lore: The hide of the Touroto, an almost invincible Bull-like creature, is said to be pierced only by the horn of the Touroto itself, making it extremely valuable.

__m.name: Auxetic Capacitor
__m.lore: This pendant is not much more than a battery on a string, but a curious combination of Avos and electromagic seem to have left it with the ability to charge power from its surroundings on its own.
